scripts.check: biome check . && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run openapi:check
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/sg-rules && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/core/testing && tsc -p packages/ui && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p e2e
scripts.e2e: bun run --cwd apps/web build && playwright test
scripts.dev: bun run --cwd apps/server dev & bun run --cwd apps/web dev; wait
